title: Removing isolated variables
statement: For a raw constraint satisfaction instance $P$, form an instance whose variables are precisely those occurring in at least one constraint scope. Its constraint multiset is obtained by replacing each constraint of $P$ with the corresponding constraint over these participating variables, preserving multiplicities; the resulting instance has at least one constraint, and every variable occurs in a constraint scope.
hypotheses_covered: variables of the resulting instance are exactly those occurring in some constraint scope of $P$
